label: ACS-Cymru Gateway
info:
# __GATEWAY_NAME__

This flow is a STARTING POINT, not a finished integration. It does two things:

1. publishes a gateway heartbeat every 30s, which is what makes this gateway show ONLINE
2. publishes one device DBIRTH on demand, to demonstrate zero-touch onboarding

## Adding your own device

Edit the **ADD YOUR OWN DEVICE** function node, change `DEVICE_ID` to whatever your machine
should be called, and inject it. The device will appear in the dashboard's **quarantine queue** --
unregistered devices are held there and their data is dropped until an operator approves them.
That is the intended path: you do not pre-register anything.

Once approved, publish DDATA on
`spBv1.0/__SPARKPLUG_GROUP__/DDATA/__SPARKPLUG_ID__/<your-device-id>` and it will land in the
historian.

## What you may NOT publish

The broker confines this gateway to `spBv1.0/+/+/__SPARKPLUG_ID__/#`. A message published under
any other edge node is dropped by the broker, silently, by design -- it is what stops one gateway
forging another's telemetry.

name: READ ME — this appliance publishes as __SPARKPLUG_ID__ and nothing else
info:
The broker pins the topic's edge-node segment to this gateway's own username
(`pattern readwrite spBv1.0/+/+/%u/#` in mosquitto.acl). Publishing under a different edge node
is not an error you will see -- the broker drops the message and tells the client nothing.

The credential is in `flows_cred.json`, encrypted. It is not recoverable from this appliance and
not re-issuable except by generating a new bundle in the dashboard.
